definitions.explanation: The making of laws, and the branch of government that does it. In Japan legislative power belongs to the Diet ({国会|こっかい}); 立法 is paired with {行政|ぎょうせい} (administration) and {司法|しほう} (the judiciary) as the three powers of government.

examples.japanese: ⟦{国会|こっかい}→国会：02761_kokkai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{唯一|ゆいいつ}→唯一：01666_yuiitsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{立法|りっぽう}⟦{機関|きかん}→機関：02630_kikan⟧⟦である→である：09855_dearu⟧。
examples.english: The Diet is the sole lawmaking body.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦{技術|ぎじゅつ}→技術：01389_gijutsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{立法|りっぽう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{追|お}いついて⟦いない→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: Legislation has not caught up with the new technology.

examples.japanese: {立法|りっぽう}・⟦{行政|ぎょうせい}→行政：14122_gyousei⟧・⟦{司法|しほう}→司法：09663_shihou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{三権|さんけん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{分|わ}ける→分ける：02333_wakeru⟧ことで、⟦{権力|けんりょく}→権力：10020_kenryoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{集中|しゅうちゅう}→集中：03212_shuuchuu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{防|ふせ}いでいる→防ぐ：02409_fusegu⟧。
examples.english: Separating the three powers of legislation, administration, and the judiciary prevents power from becoming concentrated.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {立法|りっぽう}⟦{機関|きかん}→機関：02630_kikan⟧: legislative body
- {立法|りっぽう}{府|ふ}: the legislature
- ⟦{議員|ぎいん}→議員：02660_giin⟧{立法|りっぽう}: legislation introduced by Diet members (rather than by the cabinet)
- {立法|りっぽう}⟦{措置|そち}→措置：05519_sochi⟧: legislative measures

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{立法権|りっぽうけん}→立法権：28067_rippouken⟧: legislative power
- ⟦{立方|りっぽう}→立方：24083_rippou⟧: cube (mathematics) — same reading, unrelated
